$comment: JRM Studio manifest. Source of truth for the cross-repo sync engine in sync/ (see docs/sync.md and sync/README.md), which reads this file on every run. Fields fall into three tiers and the format does not otherwise distinguish them. EXECUTED — repo, optIn.base, optIn.agents/skills/prompts/instructions, targetPaths and tokens decide which files are written where; getting one wrong changes the output. RECORDED INSIDE optIn — optIn.health and optIn.workflows are native kinds (sync/lib/manifest.mjs NATIVE_KINDS): health files are inherited from this backbone repo and reusable workflows are called via uses:, so neither is ever copied. They have the same shape as the executed keys beside them but produce no write; they document what a member relies on. DESCRIPTIVE — framework, packageManager and notes appear only in --dry-run output and have no runtime consumer at all. Only repo, optIn and tokens are validated, so nothing here fails if a recorded or descriptive field is wrong. A wrong recorded field is worse than a missing one: an executed field that is wrong turns CI red and gets fixed, while a recorded one can stay quietly wrong forever and looks equally authoritative to every future reader — and most of those readers are agents with no independent source to check against. Verify them against the member's default branch, and pin anything worth defending in sync/test/manifest.test.mjs. See sync/README.md#member-entries.

optInSyntax.$comment: Each member.optIn.<kind> is either the string "*" (all canon of that kind), an array of names, or false (opt out). base/health are booleans.

tokens.$comment: Vendored design tokens from the OTHER private backbone repo jrmoulckers/studio (package @jrm/tokens). Registry-free: the sync engine copies studio's committed dist/ tree verbatim into each opted-in member (Option A). The whole sourceBase tree is mirrored today; a future optional per-member `include` (array of sub-globs under sourceBase) may narrow this without a breaking schema change. Per-member opt-in lives in members[].tokens, kept separate from optIn because the source is an external repo, not the .github canon.

members.notes: New consumer web product. Adopts the full canonical layer.
Game-night scoring app; already carries committed design context. Adopts most of the layer; keeps its own design-engineer locally.
Origin of most canon; maintains its own richer, product-specific AI layer. Consumes shared health + reusable workflows only.
Pure-client media hub for books and audiobooks. Svelte/Vite PWA at repo root; first member to consume vendored @jrm/tokens.

Local-first game library PWA. Svelte 5 + Vite at repo root, IndexedDB via idb, vite-plugin-pwa. Separate bridge/ Cloudflare Worker (OAuth token exchange, KV cache, CORS allowlist) with its own toolchain, so this member is not backend-free. Opted in with "*": its partial canon set came from a hand-typed list in a scaffold script, not a curation decision, so freezing it would preserve a first-pass guess.
